title: Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00968v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. translated_title: 结构无关的因果表征学习
translated_abstract: 因果表征学习旨在利用数据生成背后的因果结构来发现鲁棒特征。现有方法需要事先指定因果结构，然而不同的结构要求本质上互不兼容的不变性约束，且结构设定错误会导致表征丢失预测信息。我们提出了SaCRL，这是一个无需先验结构知识即可联合识别因果结构并学习相应不变表征的框架。我们的方法将结构选择表述为在候选不变性上基于HSIC违规度量的软优化问题，并通过自适应权重自动聚焦于可实现的结构。我们为结构识别提供了理论保证，包括在随机特征近似下、不变性满足以及分布外泛化方面的保证。在实验上，SaCRL能够恢复真实的（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SaCRL框架，无需先验因果结构知识即可通过基于HSIC的软优化联合识别因果结构并学习不变表征，同时为结构识别、不变性满足和分布外泛化提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns invariant representations without prior structural knowledge, using HSIC-based soft optimization with adaptive weights, and provides theoretical guarantees for structure identification, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization.
